cohort: Women undergoing cesarean sections due to severe preeclampsia, excluding those with mild preeclampsia, multiple pregnancies, other medical disorders, eclampsia, or GA following spinal anesthesia failure.
finding: General anesthesia resulted in significantly lower Apgar scores at both 1 and 5 minutes compared to spinal anesthesia, indicating a higher proportion of birth asphyxia, but did not significantly affect maternal and perinatal mortality.
